fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on City of Miami public-utility and transportation franchise contracts (including criticism of Florida Power & Light Company agreements and bus obligations), discussion of upcoming municipal elections and civic reform demands, and commentary on Florida state politics (including Governor John W. Martin and Park Trammell). Also features local news briefs, society and entertainment listings, sports developments, tourism/seasonal rate commentary, real-estate promotion, letters to the editor, and advertisements and legal notices.
contributor: J. G. DU PUIS, M. D.
